title: Catalyst Funded Cardano Startup Booths at Rare Evo 2026

ms.promise:
Deliverables include public announcements across Rare Network’s social media platforms (X, LinkedIn, Discord, etc.) promoting the availability of 5 free exhibitor booths for Cardano-focused projects new to Rare Evo. Posts will include eligibility criteria, application instructions, and deadlines. 
Output 1.1: Social Media Campaign
・A minimum of 5 social media posts promoting the opportunity to apply.

Output 1.2: Application Portal
・Live application form website for projects to apply for booth (launched on https://rareevo.io or https://amplifycardano.io or similar site)
・Application will ask for project name, what year the project started, project summary, how many team members, impact on the Cardano ecosystem and how they build on Cardano. 

Output 1.3: Documentation
・Website/ Product Design, (screenshots and descirption of existing Amplify Cardano website with Booth application added)
・ Budget Bakdown (where costs are allocated to)
・ Project plan (outlining the initiative’s scope and execution strategy)
ms.criteria:
The milestone is accepted when the booth opportunity is publicly promoted via social media and community is aware of the opportunity. There will be a period of marketing, before the application portal is opened to create hype and a limited time to submit.

・5 posts that will promote Cardano projects to navigate to the site and apply for a booth. 
・Links to posts.

A publicly accessible application portal hosted on Rare Network infrastructure.

Systems supporting proposal intake, review, and communication.

ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria
The milestone is accepted when:
・The application portal is live, functional, and publicly accessible
・Eligible Cardano projects can successfully submit applications
・Booth details and the selection process are clearly explained in written report (screenshots of backend and UX)
・Promotional outreach is visible across Rare Network channels
・5 social media posts which tag each winning project. Post winners on website as well.
